forensic_breakdown.name: RZ-Correction Rotation Inversion Artifact
forensic_breakdown.mechanism: The RZ(51.843°) gate inserted into the test circuit mechanically rotated the state vector toward the |1> basis (z = -1.0) on ibm_fez. In controlled runs (N=12), delta_F = +0.002 +- 0.006 against random and sign-flipped controls. Indistinguishable from zero.

forensic_breakdown.name: Plug-In Entropy Sample Ceiling Artifact (136-Bit Negentropy)
forensic_breakdown.mechanism: In 10^6 shots on a 156-qubit processor, all shots were distinct. The plug-in entropy formula evaluated to log2(10^6) = 19.9316 bits. The '136-bit gap' (156 - 19.93 = 136.07 bits) is a mathematical ceiling of the sample count, not physical negentropy. Sum of single-qubit marginals is 149.7 bits (nearly maximally mixed).

forensic_breakdown.name: Bell Metric Corpus Mixing Artifact (Phi = 0.7734 Threshold)
forensic_breakdown.mechanism: Circuits spanning 2 to 127 qubits were all scored with the 2-qubit Bell formula P(00)+P(11). High-qubit circuits trivially scored ~0, while 2-qubit circuits scored ~0.2-0.8. The bimodal distribution was caused by mixing different circuit families, not a physical phase transition.

summary: Every primary empirical claim of the tau-phase packet was conclusively refuted by hardware self-tests, dimensional contradictions, or analysis artifacts. The system must permanently quarantine theta_lock.
